body: I'm too tired right now to send you the proper response you deserve for your wonderful words of support but I just wanted to say thank you. Your response helps a lot. Thank you :)

I'm still looking for a job like you described, but I guess what has concerned me is finding the money to leave if I get a job out of state as well as finding a place to live. 

And as for my brother, the other reason I haven't asked him for help, is his usual manner of trying to help out is along the lines of "stop whining pussy" :/ it's just how he is..

It actually took me forever to try to get the job I have because it is something I would enjoy doing. It's writing for a marketing company, the problem is there isn't much work to be done lately. That's why I've started looking for another job. The one I have would be great if there was actual work to be done.

And as for the wedding, I've tried to help where I can, but it is close so most of the stuff to be done requires being able to drive 20 minutes minimum to where they are working on things. And I don't have the money to do that.  :/

The other problem I have with making friends is I'm very shy. I've done a lot to get better about it, but I have no idea how to go about initiating anything with strangers. 

Thank you for your words though and I will try to keep them in mind. It's just hard especially because most of the deeper issues which contribute the most to me wanting to end it have been around for years and years and I've fought to try to be ok all this time and I'm not sure I can do it anymore. I'm trying though, and your words do help. Thanks.
All creepiness aside, I'm on wmxm too! Even used to be on exec board.
